rulesVersion: SF homebrew Beta v1.1, last updated 2026-06-05

sources.rules: Jet Lag H&S SF Rules Modifications.md

warnings: Dog Parks: sheet has 33 rows; rules prose says 36. Using sheet as authoritative.
Museums: de Young Museum geocoded by address fallback because Maps link lacked coordinates.
Museums: Exploratorium geocoded by address fallback because Maps link lacked coordinates.
Farmers Markets ingested but disabled; rules doc marks this homebrew question untested.
All Muni Stops ingested as reference-only data; Game Valid Stations remains the hiding-station universe.
Transit Line uses SFMTA GTFS stop lists for SFMTA routes; non-SFMTA lines fall back to curated valid-station line metadata.
